# RFC-0001: A document with only the legacy ToC pair

<!--toc:start-->
- [Summary](#summary)
- [Problem Statement](#problem-statement)
- [References](#references)
<!--toc:end-->

## Summary

Every v1 document in the fleet looks like this: one ToC pair and no
`docz:` marker anywhere. Inference is what reads it, and the walker must
report the ToC region without claiming the document is structured.
